attempts.text:
**The window starts on the anchor `selB`.** Column 0 is a spine column, carried by 100% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0.4% of calls, and the model names `selB` in 99% of calls with 0.05 bits. Column 1 is a fork, in a region of plasticity in 92% of calls, where `yiaY` is carried by 90% and an IS1-like element transposase by 30%.

**Column 2 is a spine, `aldB`**, carried by 92%, in a region of plasticity in 94% of calls, named in 86% with 0.46 bits. Then columns 3 to 17 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 59 to 94% of calls, named in 80 to 97% (mean 93%): the model is most hesitant at column 3, a hypothetical protein, named in 80% with 0.98 bits. A second branch of 3 families runs through columns 8 to 10, each carried by 33 to 35%, a hypothetical protein, an MFS transporter and an AraC family transcriptional regulator.

**Columns 18 to 33 are a spine**, carried by 94 to 97%, in a region of plasticity in 0.4 to 25% of calls, named in 91 to 98% (mean 96%). The `xyl` genes there, [[sugar transport and xylose use]], and `glyQ` to `glyS` are named readily; the model is least sure at `glyS`, named in 91% with 0.27 bits. Column 34 is variable, an IS3 family transposase carried by 59%, named in 90% with 0.69 bits.

**Columns 35 to 54 are a spine**, carried by 93 to 97%, in a region of plasticity in 2 to 59% of calls, named in 72 to 96% (mean 91%). The `dpp` genes, [[dipeptide transport]], are named least at `dppF`, 72%, and the model hesitates most at `hokA`, 0.42 bits. The `bcs` genes follow, [[cellulose biosynthesis]], through variable columns 57 to 60 and spines at 56 and 61, in a region of plasticity in 65 to 81% of calls.

**The window ends at `mdtF`**, column 79, carried by 59%, after fork and variable columns 73 to 79, in a region of plasticity in 2 to 4% of calls, named in 77 to 94% (mean 87%). Across the window the model names 92% of genes at 0.26 bits; inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.42 against 0.18 bits, and names about as many genes, 90% against 93%.

label: selB
facts:
WINDOW: the selB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor selB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 120 to 199 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying selB once); 43,196 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.26 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 30,977 calls, named 95%, 0.17 bits; shell 12,133 calls, named 86%, 0.49 bits; cloud 86 calls, named 14%, 1.57 bits. Outside an RGP 29,077 calls, named 93%, 0.18 bits; inside an RGP 14,119 calls, named 90%, 0.42 bits. Columns: 50 spine, 9 fork, 21 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.42 against 0.18 bits) and names about as many genes (90% against 93%); 14,119 of the 43,196 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 3 ("hypothetical protein") 0.98 bits, RGP 94%; column 34 ("IS3 family transposase") 0.69 bits, RGP 2%; column 4 (yiaW) 0.60 bits, RGP 94%. The 27 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 91%, 0.36 bits on average; the other 53 columns: named 93%, 0.21 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 2 (spine), RGP 94%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0.4%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0.4%. Genes: selB. named 99%; 0.05 bits.
2. column 1 fork: RGP 92%. named 91%; 0.41 bits.
   1: yiaY S 90% "iron-containing alcohol dehydrogena…"; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 30%
3. column 2 spine: share 92%, all P, RGP 94%. Genes: aldB. named 86%; 0.46 bits.
4. columns 3-17 (15 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 59-94%. named 80-97% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 3, named 80%, 0.98 bits.
   a second branch of 3 families through columns 8-10, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 33-35%, all S; the branch's families: "hypothetical protein", "MFS transporter", "AraC family transcriptional regulator"
   3 fork: "hypothetical protein" S 54%; also "type II toxin-antitoxin system HicA fam…" S 11%, "hypothetical protein" S 11%
   4 fork: yiaW P 71% "DUF3302 domain-containing protein"; also "type II toxin-antitoxin system HicB fam…" S 11%
   5 variable: yiaV S 69%
   6 variable: yiaU S 65% "LysR family transcriptional regulat…"
   7 variable: yiaT S 66% "MipA/OmpV family protein"
   8 fork: araD S 80%
   9 fork: sgbU S 79%
   10 fork: ulaD S 80%; also yiaM S 11%
   11 fork: lyxK S 75%; also "DUF4862 family protein" S 10%
   columns 12-17 variable, share 70-89%, all S: yiaO "TRAP transporter substrate-binding…" 78%, yiaN "2,3-diketo-L-gulonate TRAP transpor…" 79%, yiaM "2,3-diketo-L-gulonate TRAP transpor…" 70%, yiaL "YhcH/YjgK/YiaL family protein" 82%, yiaK "Ldh family oxidoreductase" 87%, yiaJ "IclR family transcriptional regulat…" 89%
5. columns 18-33 (16 columns) spine: share 94-97%, all P, RGP 0.4-25%. Genes: ysaA "4Fe-4S dicluster domain-containing…", avtA, malS, bax, xylR, xylH, xylG, xylF "D-xylose ABC transporter substrate-…", xylA, xylB, yiaB "inner membrane protein YiaB", yiaA "YiaA/YiaB family inner membrane pro…", wecH, ysaB "YsaB family lipoprotein", glyQ, glyS "glycine--tRNA ligase subunit beta". named 91-98% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 33 (glyS), named 91%, 0.27 bits.
6. column 34 variable: RGP 2%. named 90%; 0.69 bits.
   34: "IS3 family transposase" S 59%
7. columns 35-54 (20 columns) spine: share 93-97%, all P, RGP 2-59%. Genes: hokA, ysaE, cspE, yiaG "HTH-type transcriptional regulator", yiaF "DUF3053 domain-containing protein", ghrB, yiaD "OmpA family lipoprotein", bisC, yiaC "N-acetyltransferase", tag, yhjY "autotransporter domain-containing p…", yhjX "MFS transporter", eptB, dppA, dppB, dppC, dppD "oligopeptide/dipeptide ABC transpor…", dppF, yhjV "amino acid permease", ldrD. named 72-96% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 52 (dppF), named 72%; most hesitant at column 35 (hokA), 0.42 bits.
8. column 55 variable: RGP 67%. named 84%; 0.45 bits.
   55: bcsG S 84% "cellulose biosynthesis protein BcsG"
9. column 56 spine: share 92%, all P, RGP 71%. Genes: bcsF. named 86%; 0.41 bits.
10. columns 57-60 (4 columns) variable: RGP 77-81%. named 87-91% (mean 89%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 57, named 87%, 0.57 bits.
   57: bcsE S 82%
   58: bcsR S 89%
   59: bcsQ S 81%
   60: bcsA S 84%
11. column 61 spine: share 90%, all S, RGP 73%. Genes: bcsB. named 91%; 0.43 bits.
12. column 62 variable: RGP 65%. named 93%; 0.32 bits.
   62: bcsZ S 89%
13. columns 63-72 (10 columns) spine: share 91-96%, all P, RGP 2-53%. Genes: bcsC, hmsP, dctA, yhjJ "pitrilysin family protein", kdgK, pdeH, yhjG "AsmA family protein", yhjE "MFS transporter", yhjD "YhjD/YihY/BrkB family envelope inte…", rcdB. named 93-96% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 68 (pdeH), named 93%; most hesitant at column 63 (bcsC), 0.25 bits.
14. columns 73-79 (7 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 2-4%. named 77-94% (mean 87%), fewest named at column 78, named 77%; most hesitant at column 79, 0.25 bits.
   columns 73-77 variable, share 71-89%, all P: yhjB "response regulator transcription fa…" 89%, treF 86%, ccp 80%, gadA 77%, gadX 71%
   78 fork: gadW P 67%; also hdeA P 15%
